result.title: Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM
result.summary: Recursive reasoning models refine persistent internal states by repeatedly applying learned operators. We investigate whether adding a persistent intermediate state that integrates repeated updates of a faster state through the same operator improves predictive performance relative to each model family's baseline at matched parameter counts. We define this organisation operationally and implement it within three architectures: the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) and Universal Reasoning Model (URM). Using the official codebases on ARC-AGI-1, we compare each baseline with its parameter-matched nested variant. We evaluate held-out queries from tasks whose demonstrations were available during training. The experiments use a single-GPU budget far below the published training protocols. Under the tested conditions, nested variants show no consistent advantage in token accuracy, predictive loss or exact solving, which remains near zero for all configurations. The results therefore leave the hypothesis open. We specify a confirmatory comparison, with an informative baseline, multiple seeds, controls that isolate nesting and predefined criteria, to determine whether this organisation merits further development.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 ARC-AGI-1 上操作化定义了「嵌套共享算子递归」（用同一算子反复更新一个整合快速状态的持久中间状态），在 HRM、TRM、URM 三种递归推理架构中各自实现参数匹配的嵌套变体并与基线对比；在远低于原训练协议的算力预算下未发现一致优势，精确求解率接近零，作者因此给出可确认性实验设计。
AI.relevance_reason: 共享算子递归与持久中间状态对应 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态生成与更新这一方法线索，其负结果和验证协议可供核查；但该工作为纯符号抽象推理、未验证收益，能否迁移到视觉 latent 推理需较多核查。
